standard.summary: TurboCore 调试和分析参数：profile 记录各 TurboCore 组件的耗时统计；strict 开启严格验证模式（错误时 fail-closed 而非 fallback）；tuned_kernel_disable 禁用特定调优 kernel（测试/调试用）；workspace_mb 设置 TurboCore 内部工作区大小。
standard.effect: profile 将 TurboCore 各阶段的时间细分记录到日志，帮助定位性能瓶颈；update_shadow_mode 控制 shadow 权重更新的时机（用于 TurboCore 的回签验证流程）。
standard.whenToUse: 调试 TurboCore 行为或性能分析时使用。正常训练保持默认（不开启这些调试选项）。
standard.avoidWhen: strict 模式会在 TurboCore 组件失败时立即报错（而非自动 fallback），只在调试时使用。

optionDescriptions.aggressive: 内核和策略开得更满，赚得多也更容易出幺蛾子。

standard_en.summary: TurboCore debugging and analysis parameters: profile records per-component timing statistics; strict enables strict validation mode (fail-closed on an error rather than falling back); tuned_kernel_disable disables a particular tuned kernel (for testing and debugging); workspace_mb sets the size of TurboCore's internal workspace.
standard_en.effect: profile records a breakdown of the time spent in each TurboCore stage to the log, which helps locate a performance bottleneck; update_shadow_mode controls when the shadow weights update (used by TurboCore's sign-back verification flow).
standard_en.whenToUse: Use it when debugging TurboCore behaviour or analysing performance. Keep the defaults for normal training (leave these debugging options off).
standard_en.avoidWhen: strict mode raises immediately when a TurboCore component fails (instead of falling back automatically), so use it only while debugging.

optionDescriptions.aggressive: Kernels and strategies turned up further: it gains more, and misbehaves more easily.
